packages.objective: 为 reflection、me 与 private-knowledge 建立页面实例/session owner、生命周期资源清理和迟到响应隔离。
deliverables: reflection 完整 session owner 与统一 suspend/dispose 清理
me 页面私有 request owner 与重复 onShow 去重
private-knowledge 页面私有 request owner、可取消删除轮询与重复 onShow 去重
三个页面的独立竞态测试和 600/1024 布局断点
nonGoals: 不修改 practice、mock-exam、essay-task 或 subpackage-shared-src/task-runtime
不修改 backend、API/OpenAPI、生成类型、存储 key、导航注册、支付或 data_rights
不修改岸岸、抽题、公式识别、错因智能逻辑
不集成尚未稳定的阶段三公式候选接口
不部署、不上传、不推送，不声明全产品或生产就绪

migrationPolicy.dataBackfill: No schema, storage-key, or data migration belongs to this package.
migrationPolicy.rollback: Revert only files in allowedPaths; no persistent user data is rewritten.

compatibilityPolicy.strategy: Keep existing API payloads, routes, storage keys and visible business semantics; only reject stale page-owned effects.
compatibilityPolicy.supportedVersions: Existing WeChat page and API contracts at baseline a46e655cd.
compatibilityPolicy.removalGate: Any API, route, storage or business-semantic change requires a new release unit and owner approval.

requiredAcceptanceScenarios.assertion: reflection rejects same-user token/generation and account-switch late effects and clears replay, poll, recording, preview, speech and timers on hide/unload
me accepts only the newest visible request for the current page instance and exact session owner
private-knowledge accepts only the newest visible exact-owner request and cancels deletion polling waits on hide/unload

stopConditions: A required change falls outside allowedPaths or touches another window's tests
A required behavior changes API, storage, route, payment, data_rights or business-intelligence contracts
The stage-three formula candidate interface is not stable
A destructive, deployment, upload or push action is required

packages.objective: 补齐错误模式与日结算的精确岸岸上下文，并交付只保存用户显式偏好的长期记忆、短期对话清除、用户管理页和隐私数据闭环。
deliverables: 可校验归属的 error_pattern 引用和包含执行状态的日计划引用
长期记忆列表、幂等新增、revision 修改、单条删除、清空和注入开关 API
短期对话统计与全部清除 API
我的与数据隐私可达的岸岸记忆管理页
个人数据概览、导出和账户擦除中的岸岸记忆数据
数据库迁移、OpenAPI 与小程序生成类型
nonGoals: 不从普通聊天或 AI 推断自动创建长期记忆
不把成绩、能力、错题、计划、资格或岗位事实复制进聊天记忆
不引入 Mem0、LangMem、向量数据库或新的 Agent 编排框架
不合并小程序与 iLink 会话上下文，仅在用户清除和导出时一并处理
不修改商业权益、模型路由、学习脑事实所有权或生产发布状态
不部署、不上传、不推送，不声明全产品或生产就绪

migrationPolicy.dataBackfill: No existing chat is promoted to long-term memory; the settings row is created lazily and absence means enabled with zero explicit items.
migrationPolicy.rollback: Before production use, downgrade removes only the new long-term memory tables and their disable trigger; already-existing short-term memory migration remains intact.

compatibilityPolicy.strategy: Add new v2 endpoints and additive response fields; existing Companion ask callers continue to work with no long-term items.
compatibilityPolicy.supportedVersions: Existing companion ask v2 plus companion-memory-control@v1.
compatibilityPolicy.removalGate: Changing category meaning, ownership, hard-delete semantics or default enablement requires a superseding contract and release unit.

requiredAcceptanceScenarios.assertion: duplicate creates replay one item, stale revisions cannot overwrite newer content, account isolation holds, and clear operations converge idempotently
error-pattern and daily-settlement references authorize only exact owned versions and retrieve the named pattern plus current task execution facts
the memory page renders loading, empty and populated truth, gates mutations in flight, and recovers stale or uncertain operations by reloading server state
registered plans and reports subpackage routes persist as Companion launch context while malformed or traversal routes remain rejected

stopConditions: A required change would let AI or ordinary chat silently create durable memory
A required change would duplicate a canonical score, ability, plan, qualification or position fact
A required path overlaps the frozen frontend lifecycle unit or falls outside allowedPaths
A destructive production migration, deployment, upload or push is required
